name: Welo Crystal Fire Opal
color: Crystal with full-spectrum play of colour
description: A luminous crystal opal from the highlands of Wollo, alive with broad flashes of red, green and violet that move across the stone with every turn of the hand. Hand-selected for its rolling-flash pattern and exceptional transparency.

name: Royal Blue Sapphire
description: A velvety royal-blue sapphire with saturated colour across the table and lively brilliance from a precision-recut pavilion. An heirloom centre stone.

name: Crimson Ruby Cushion
description: An unheated ruby of rare saturation with a strong red fluorescence that makes the stone glow in daylight. Accompanied by an independent laboratory report.

name: Verdant Emerald Step Cut
description: A classically proportioned emerald with a soft, garden-like interior and a deep, cool green that holds its colour under every light.

name: Padparadscha Sapphire Pear
description: The lotus-blossom colour of a true padparadscha: a delicate balance of pink and orange, untreated and certified.

name: Tsavorite Garnet
description: A bright, high-dispersion tsavorite whose vivid green outshines many emeralds, with a hardness suited to everyday wear.
